findings.text: Meta channel_dark: all 155 leads and all CPL gains ($16.99, -30% WoW) are Meta-sourced, but zero campaign-level breakdowns are visible.
Google spent $1,038.67 over 28 days — $736.30 on BWS Search Campaign — with 0 recorded conversions and 173 clicks. Pure spend leak.
Overdue SOW milestone: Stripe Products QA'd & Done (due 2026-07-20, CRM/GHL) has no confirmed completed event in current data.
3-day trend (Aug 21–23): leads = 8, 0, 0 vs prior 3 days (Aug 18–20): leads = 4, 0, 0. Weekend zero-lead pattern is structural; Mon–Thu avg ~9 leads/day holds steady.
GHL shows 137 opportunities created but 0 won and 0 appointments in 28 days — 155 leads entering pipeline with no downstream conversion recorded.

suggestions.text: Audit Google Ads call-conversion tracking on BWS Search Campaign; $736.30 spent with 0 conversions confirms pixel/call-tracking failure.
suggestions.monday_update: Google Ads has spent $1,038.67 over 28 days ($736.30 on BWS - Search Campaign - Calls alone) with zero recorded conversions and only 173 clicks — the conversion action is almost certainly misconfigured or the call tag is not firing. Pull the Google Tag diagnostics and confirm the call conversion action is active and linked to the correct phone number in the ad. Success is confirmed when at least one test call registers as a conversion in Google Ads within 48 hours. Complete by 2026-08-26.

suggestions.text: Shift $15/day from Google to Meta while tracking is broken; Meta is the only channel delivering leads at $16.99 CPL.
suggestions.monday_update: Google Ads is spending ~$14–17/day with zero confirmed conversions while Meta is producing all 155 leads at $16.99 CPL. Reduce Google daily budget by $15/day and add $15/day to the active Meta campaign. This shift is capped at 20% of current Google budget and is reversible once tracking is confirmed working (see S1). Success check: Meta lead volume holds above 8 leads per active weekday with CPL remaining below $20 by 2026-08-28.

suggestions.text: Watch GHL pipeline: 137 opps, 0 won, 0 appointments — re-check 2026-08-28 to confirm whether intake automation is leaking.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 137 opportunities created against 155 leads with zero appointments booked and zero won deals in 28 days. This is either a CRM workflow gap or the Becklar/BWS intake paths are not triggering follow-up automations correctly — it is not an ads problem. Check whether the automated appointment or follow-up sequence fires on new opportunities by reviewing one live test contact end-to-end. If zero appointments still show by 2026-08-28, escalate to Ahmed/Ali as an ops fix before increasing ad spend further.
